_comment_purpose: Test LES physics model with high-resolution mesh
_test_objective: Validate physics.model='les' works correctly - MOST comprehensive test
_expected: ~10M cells, 4-6 hour runtime, LES turbulence fields (k, nuSgs)

case_info.notes: Testing LES model - most expensive test, validates complete system

physics._comment_model: TEST: Large Eddy Simulation (most complex physics)
physics._expected_fields: U, p, k (SGS kinetic energy), nuSgs (SGS viscosity)
physics._sgs_model: Should use Smagorinsky or WALE SGS model
physics._note: LES requires fine mesh (20+ cells/D) and small timesteps
physics._comment_turbulence: Smagorinsky SGS model (most common for LES)
physics._alternatives: Could use WALE, dynamicKEqn, or kEqn

numerics._comment_profile: Standard 2nd order schemes (LES needs at least 2nd order)
numerics._note: Could use 'precise' profile for even higher accuracy
numerics._comment_co: Lower Courant number for LES stability (0.3-0.5 typical)
numerics._why: LES resolves smaller scales → needs smaller timesteps

mesh._comment_resolution: 20 cells/D = MINIMUM for LES (25-30 recommended for publication)
mesh._les_requirement: LES needs finer mesh than RANS to resolve turbulent eddies
mesh._wall_resolution: Small vessels (3.7mm) → 74 cells, Large vessels (7mm) → 140 cells

boundary_layers._comment_enabled: Boundary layers CRITICAL for LES wall resolution
boundary_layers._comment_yplus: y+ ≈ 1 for LES (wall-resolved, NO wall models)
boundary_layers._why: LES MUST resolve near-wall eddies - y+ < 1 required
boundary_layers._wall_model_warning: Wall models for LES are research topic - use wall-resolved

surface_refinement._comment_levels: Surface refinement for geometry accuracy (LES needs fine resolution)

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_quality: Tighter quality for LES (better mesh than RANS)

inlet._les_note: May want to add inlet turbulence for LES (synthetic turbulence)

simulation_control._comment_cycles: 5 cycles minimum for LES (10+ recommended for statistics)
simulation_control._why: LES needs many cycles to average out turbulent fluctuations
simulation_control._comment_write: Write every 0.005s = 200 samples/sec (high frequency for LES)

_test_checklist.1_les_turbulence_fields: Verify k (SGS kinetic energy) and nuSgs (SGS viscosity) files created
_test_checklist.2_no_omega: Should NOT have omega field (that's RANS)
_test_checklist.3_sgs_model: Check turbulenceProperties shows LES with Smagorinsky
_test_checklist.5_small_timestep: Timestep should be small (dt ~ 1e-5 to 5e-5 for Co=0.5)
_test_checklist.7_solver_runs: LES solver completes without stability issues
_test_checklist.8_compare_rans: Optional: compare time-averaged LES with RANS results
_test_checklist.9_turbulent_structures: Visualize instantaneous fields - should see turbulent eddies
_test_checklist.10_statistics: Can compute time-averaged fields from last 2-3 cycles

_expected_behavior.timestep: ~2-5x smaller than RANS (due to lower Co and finer mesh)
_expected_behavior.runtime: ~10-20x longer than RANS coarse (fine mesh + small dt + more cycles)
_expected_behavior.disk_space: ~50-80 GB (10M cells, 5 cycles, high write frequency)
_expected_behavior.turbulence: Should see instantaneous turbulent fluctuations in velocity/pressure
_expected_behavior.averaging: Time-average last cycles → should approach RANS results

_validation_methods.1_energy_spectrum: Plot turbulent energy spectrum → should show -5/3 slope in inertial range
_validation_methods.2_reynolds_stresses: Compute <u'u'> from fluctuations → validate turbulence intensity
_validation_methods.4_instantaneous: Visualize instantaneous Q-criterion → see vortex structures
_validation_methods.5_sgs_contribution: Check nuSgs/nu ratio → SGS model should contribute ~10-30%

_why_this_is_comprehensive_test.1_complex_physics: LES is most complex turbulence model
_why_this_is_comprehensive_test.6_all_features: Uses boundary layers, surface refinement, Windkessel BCs
_why_this_is_comprehensive_test.7_validation: Results can be compared against RANS for consistency

_expected_runtime: 4-6 hours (mesh: 30 min parallel, solver: 3.5-5.5 hours on 8 cores)
_disk_space_warning: This test will generate 50-80 GB of data. Ensure sufficient disk space!
